This '''Timeline''' is a rough estimation of the universe of [[Wuthering Waves]]. LD (Landing Date) refers to the year that [[Rover]] lands in [[Solaris-3]] and starts the game's events.

References are provided as much as possible.

{{color|old|Informations and order may be incorrect, please use Timeline as a reference and not fully factually.}}

==Pre-First Lament==
*'''?''' — [[The Farwatcher]] and eight other interstellar probes are launched by the [[Pre-Lament Civilization]].
*'''?''' — The Tethys Institute proposes, approves, and executes [[Resolution K626]] as the Lament begins.
==First Global Lament==
*'''10,000 years before LD''' — There have been five global [[The Lament|Laments]] and more than 300,000 regional Laments since 10,000 years before LD until LD.<ref>[[Advance toward the Future from Today|Chapter I, Act VIII, Advance toward the Future from Today]]</ref>. The first Global Lament hit Solaris, rewriting the foundational of matter of the universe into frequencies. Gravity is the only pre-Lament law of physics that still applies.
*'''?''' — The [[Fractsidus]] is founded
*'''?''' — Rover arrives from the [[Homeland Civilization]] with the mission to stop the Lament on Solaris-3. The SkyArk space station, a [[Court of Savantae]] satellite, witnesses Rover falling through the [[Etheric Sea]]. The Etheric Sea is an atmospheric [[Waveworn Phenomenon|Waveworn Phenomena]] that blankets the globe and prevents humans from reaching outer space. [[Schwarzloch|Weiying]], one of the researchers aboard the SkyArk station, is the earliest confirmed identity of the Grand Architect.
*'''?''' — The [[Roya Frostlands]] becomes [[Solaris-3|Solaris's]] new pole following the first [[The Lament|Lament]] ever recorded, when its once-lush forests were transformed into an endless ice sheet.<ref name=":0">[[Post-Lament Anthropocene: Comprehensive Mirror for Historians — Exostrider]]</ref>. The Roya live on this 
==Post First Lament==
===Second Lament===
**When the second recorded [[The Lament|Lament]] strikes the Roya Frostlands, [[Threnodian]] [[Aleph-1]]  - having arrived alongside the [[Exostrider]] from outer space- unleashes the [[Void Storm]]. The Exostrider resonates with [[Aemeath]] and seals Aleph-1 above Solaris-3, behind the [[Stridergate]]. This is the only remaining connection to outer space after the descent of the Etheric Sea. To counter the devastation caused by the overflow of Voidmatter, the Exostrider shed its own components and transformed them into the [[Exoswarm]], restoring [[Lahai-Roi]]'s damaged ecology. It also guided the [[Roya Tribe|Roya]] tribe to relocate their settlements in Lahai-Roi, beneath the frozen expanse.<ref name=":0" /> 
===Unknown Location===
*'''?''' — Rover makes enemies out of many organizations. One of said organizations creates [[Camellya]] to assassinate Rover. It is likely that this organization is behind her Resonance Awakening, as she is an Artificial Resonator.<ref>Camellya's Character Story "Once Upon A Time" and her Forte Examination report.</ref>
*'''?''' — The Somnoire is created to store and analyze peoples' dreams and search them for potential solutions to the Lament. The [[Ivory Gatekeeper]] and [[Ebony Gatekeeper]] are created as the Somnoire's guardians, and Rover is granted the authority of "Dreamwalker" within its system.

===Black Shores===
*'''?''' — The Tethys System is created by an unknown civilization, likely the [[Homeland Civilization]].
*'''?''' — The Shorekeeper is created in a piece of light blue crystal made of remnant energy, gathered from the "Anchor" on the Black Shores Archipelago. Rover touches the crystal, and their frequency resonates with the crystal, awakening the [[Shorekeeper]] and allowing her to take a human form.
*'''?''' — Rover founds the [[Black Shores]] organization as a way to gather people to solve the Lament. Tethys selects the people that Rover recruits. The organization provides evacuation and support relief for locations devastated by the Lament, and brings back the Reverberation data for Shorekeeper to analyze.

==Rover's Departure==
===Black Shores===
*'''20 years before LD'''
**The Astral Modulator, Rover, steps down as the leader of the Black Shores to "abandon their memories", placing the Tethys System in charge of governing, and passing their duties as the leader on to the Shorekeeper.<ref>[[Legacy of the Lasting Night|Chapter I, Act VIII, Legacy of the Lasting Night]]</ref>
**Camellya abandons her memory and leaves the Black Shores, hoping to reunite with Rover in the future.<ref>[[Forking Paths Among the Stars]] "I will abandon my memories like (‍Rover‍) once did, sealing them away"</ref>
**The "Rover" of the Past leaves a message for the current Rover, given only if current Rover resolved the Tethys System Crisis.<ref>[[Through the Sea Thou Break]]</ref>

===Lahai-Roi===
*'''~19 years before LD''' 
**Mornye receives an acceptance letter to Startorch at 16 years old.[[Mornye/Backstory#Admission Letter]] She visits the infirmary often and is cared for by Dr. Luuk.[[Mornye/Voicelines#About Luuk Herssen]]
**She is considered a genius and becomes the youngest teaching assistant in the department of Exostrider Engineering. Mornye grades one of Chisa's papers before Chisa's disappearance into the Void Storm.
**Mornye is taken under Rover's wing while she is a student. They invite her to on an expedition to the Frostlands despite her being wheelchair-bound. This expedition is what ignites Mornye's desire for space exploration.
**Rover cares for Aemeath during this period of time.
*'''19 years before LD'''
**[[Kuchiba Chisa]] is sucked into the [[Chronorift Metropolis|Honami City]] Sonoro Sphere. This is an accident related to the Void Storm Waveworn Phenomena of Lahai-Roi.
*'''19 years before LD, after Rover's departure from Lahai-Roi'''
**Mornye graduates, and her senior thesis becomes the basis of the New Solar Ceremony.
**Mornye becomes a professor in the Department of Exostrider Engineering.
***Her first assignment after joining the Research Institute is to recreate a night sky over Lahai-Roi. The signal tower for the project is built, but the site is struck by a Voidstorm. Mornye overclocks to prevent the tower from failing and is successful, but is struck by a piece of falling debris. Her legs are irreparably injured by the debris, so she becomes the inaugural test subject for an experimental prosthetic technology. The operation succeeds, and she continues to have surgeries to refine her prosthetics. She can now walk without aid, although her prosthetics do require frequent recharging.
*'''9 years before LD'''
**[[Aemeath]] overclocks in order to resonate with the Exostrider and prevent Aleph-1 from breaking through the Stridergate. This kills her in the process, with her body vanishing from the simulation pod and turning her frequency into a "digital ghost".
***The Fractsidus had a hand in weakening the Stridergate, leading to Aemeath's death.
